claim: Accounting firms' painful jobs center on document chasing, bank-feed reconciliation and period close; core entities and authority boundaries are known before any client conversation.
precomputable: likely systems of record (GL, bank feeds, document store)
authority boundary defaults (no posting, no write-off)
must_ask: which GL/bank-feed/document systems and who owns the period
which exceptions actually cost hours (document chase vs matching vs review)
contradiction_risks: stated want 'automate the close' vs observed pain usually document collection
source-of-truth ambiguity between GL and bank feed
discovery_confidence_note: demand_signal=E, validated_demand=U; priors are catalogue+spec evidence, not interviews
limitations: No validated industry denominator; system-of-record mix varies by firm size and country

claim: Construction demand centers on job tracking, change-order chase, subcontractor coordination and progress billing; multi-party authority is the defining constraint.
precomputable: multi-party actor model (GC, subs, client, certifier)
must_ask: which PM/schedule system is authoritative and which spreadsheets shadow it
approval chain for change orders (who, thresholds)
subcontractor communication channels and evidence formats
contradiction_risks: schedule truth split across PM tool and site spreadsheets
claimed approval process vs actual email/phone approvals
limitations: Corpus has weak construction-specific supply; priors are demand-side only

claim: Course creators need student onboarding, lesson drips and community management; learner identity and consent are the sensitive boundary.
must_ask: which LMS/community/payment platforms and their data-access reality
what 'stalled learner' means to this operator
contradiction_risks: stated want 'more automation' vs pain usually unanswered questions and stalled cohorts
platform data often locked in closed SaaS
limitations: Solo-operator vs team scale changes everything; no denominator

claim: Ecommerce demand centers on cart recovery, inventory sync and support tickets; payment/PII and order authority are the hard boundaries.
precomputable: platform-detectable stack (storefront, payment, support, 3PL) from public site
stack detection via public storefront fingerprinting is unusually strong here
must_ask: inventory source of truth across locations/channels
contradiction_risks: 'inventory sync' stated as want while root cause is multi-channel ownership ambiguity
support metrics vs actual queue reality
limitations: Storefront fingerprinting shows stack, not workflow pain

claim: Education/training demand centers on enrolment, attendance, learner communication and tuition administration; guardian/consent authority is industry-specific.
must_ask: SIS/LMS and tuition-ledger systems and identity authority
session model (cohort, rolling, 1:1) and timezone spread
contradiction_risks: attendance recorded in multiple places
tuition aging blamed on parents vs actually on invoicing gaps

claim: Healthcare practice demand is administrative (appointments, no-shows, reminders, billing admin); clinical data and decisions are excluded by boundary, which shapes discovery itself.
precomputable: admin-vs-clinical boundary (clinical record is a prohibited source)
discovery must itself avoid ingesting clinical data
must_ask: no-show economics and reminder consent posture
which admin tasks consume staff hours
contradiction_risks: stated 'reduce no-shows' vs actual pain often billing exceptions
consent state scattered
discovery_confidence_note: demand_signal=E, validated_demand=U; synthetic-only pilots per prior spec
limitations: Regulated-data constraints make evidence-based discovery (scraping, log mining) mostly unavailable; question-led discovery dominates here

claim: Hospitality demand centers on reservations, guest feedback and housekeeping coordination; timing conflicts are the recurring exception class.
precomputable: property size/type inferable from public listings
must_ask: housekeeping task ownership and shift model
contradiction_risks: room-status disagreement between PMS and housekeeping reality
feedback treated as authority when it is evidence
limitations: Independent property vs chain changes system landscape entirely

claim: MSP demand centers on ticket triage, SLA/backup monitoring and client onboarding; privileged access and secrets are the hard boundary.
precomputable: MSPs are unusually legible: PSA/RMM tools are a small known set
must_ask: which PSA/RMM and their tenant hygiene
contradiction_risks: SLA clocks computed differently across tools
tenant mix-ups in shared tooling
limitations: Secrets/privileged access excluded from any automated discovery

claim: Insurance agency demand centers on lead follow-up, renewal chasing and certificate issuance; carrier record is authoritative and licensure bounds authority.
must_ask: AMS/CRM reality and carrier portal mix
renewal book size and cycle timing
licensure boundaries on who may communicate what
contradiction_risks: renewal date truth split between AMS and carrier
certificate 'urgent' claims vs actual issuance authority
limitations: Regulated advice boundary; jurisdictional variation unknown

claim: Law firm demand centers on client intake, conflict checks, document drafting and billing admin; privilege classification constrains every data flow including discovery itself.
precomputable: privilege boundary (discovery may only touch metadata)
must_ask: PMS/DMS/billing systems and matter numbering authority
contradiction_risks: intake speed wanted vs conflict-check rigor required
billing aging blamed on clients vs internal WIP release
limitations: Privilege prevents content-level evidence mining; metadata-only discovery

claim: Logistics demand centers on shipment exceptions, carrier booking, POD filing and customer notices; event ordering and idempotency dominate the data model.
precomputable: shipment/event state machines with out-of-order handling
must_ask: TMS and tracking-source mix; where POD actually lives
exception taxonomy that costs money (late, damaged, missing POD)
contradiction_risks: ETA truth conflicts across sources
'real-time visibility' wanted vs data arrives batched/late
limitations: Corpus supply thin for logistics; demand priors only

claim: Agency demand centers on content scheduling, reporting decks and retainer-lead chasing; client approval is the authoritative gate for publishing.
precomputable: agency's own public portfolio reveals client mix
must_ask: approval chain per client and turnaround expectations
reporting cadence and what clients actually read
contradiction_risks: 'save reporting time' vs real pain is approval chase
metric windows defined differently per channel
limitations: Platform API access volatility unknown per channel

claim: Mortgage broker demand centers on borrower qualification, condition chasing and file movement to close; lender portals are authoritative for status and conditions.
precomputable: document checklist archetypes per loan type
contradiction_risks: lender status conflicts with LOS state
'faster closes' wanted vs bottleneck is borrower document supply
limitations: Sensitive financial data; discovery is metadata/synthetic until authority proven

claim: Property management demand centers on tenant inquiries, rent chasing, work orders and lease filing; emergency and legal paths must stay human-owned.
precomputable: portfolio size inferable from public listings
must_ask: PMS and payment reality; where leases actually live
contradiction_risks: payment pending vs paid ambiguity
'automate tenant comms' wanted vs legal notice constraints

claim: Real estate demand centers on portal-lead response, viewing bookings and listing paperwork; speed-to-lead is the economic driver.
precomputable: public listing inventory is directly observable
must_ask: CRM/portal mix and lead routing rules
contradiction_risks: stale listings visible publicly vs claimed 'all current'
lead-response claims vs measurable portal response times
limitations: Portal API access varies by market

claim: Recruiting demand centers on candidate screening, interview scheduling and role filling; fairness-sensitive attributes and employment decisions bound automation.
precomputable: public job postings reveal role mix and volume
contradiction_risks: 'faster screening' wanted vs fairness/consent constraints
stage definitions vary per client
limitations: Fairness-sensitive; discovery must exclude protected attributes

claim: SaaS demand centers on MQL-to-demo conversion, churn reduction and shipping speed; authority is split across revenue, success and engineering owners.
precomputable: split-authority model (CRM/billing vs analytics vs CI)
public site + docs + status page reveal stack and maturity
archetype fit (ops desk spanning three planes)
must_ask: CRM/billing/analytics/CI tool reality and metric definitions
which of the three planes (revenue, success, shipping) hurts most
contradiction_risks: churn 'signal' definitions conflict between tools
engineering vs revenue priorities on same data
limitations: SaaS is also the most self-served industry; willingness to buy semi-custom unknown
